business.definitionJa: 船舶により貨物や旅客を運送する事業。日本と外国の港を結ぶ外航海運と、国内の港どうしを結ぶ内航（沿海）海運の両方を含み、コンテナ船・ばら積み船（バルカー）・LNG船・タンカー・自動車運搬船など船種は問わない。自ら船舶を運航して運送を行う船社を対象とし、船舶を保有せず運送を仲介するだけの利用運送業（フォワーダー）は含まない。
business.definitionEn: Shipping companies that operate vessels to carry cargo or passengers, spanning international (external) ocean shipping and domestic coastwise shipping, regardless of vessel type (container ship, bulk carrier, LNG carrier, tanker, car carrier). Limited to operators of the vessels themselves; forwarders who merely arrange sea freight without owning/operating ships are tagged separately.

themes.definitionJa: シリコンウエハーから製造装置・部素材、ロジック/メモリ/パワー半導体、先端パッケージングまで、半導体産業チェーン全体に関わる企業群。日本成長戦略が「フィジカル・インテリジェント・システムの中核」と位置付ける最重点分野。

themes.definitionEn: Makers of front-end semiconductor materials (wafers, photoresist, specialty gases/chemicals, CMP slurry, sputtering targets), named as a supply-chain resilience focus under Japan's economic-security critical-materials policy for semiconductors.

themes.definitionEn: Makers of semiconductor manufacturing equipment (lithography, deposition, etching, cleaning, inspection, back-end assembly) and their critical parts—a pillar of Japan's economic-security semiconductor policy.

themes.definitionEn: Companies in advanced semiconductor packaging—package substrates, encapsulants, glass-core substrates, lead frames, chiplet integration—identified by METI as critical to AI-chip performance and supply resilience.

themes.definitionEn: Makers of AI accelerator chips and the chiplet packaging/generative-AI infrastructure that support them, targeted for development support under the AI/semiconductor field of Japan's GX sector investment strategy.

themes.definitionEn: Power semiconductor makers, including SiC/GaN wide-bandgap devices, positioned by METI as a growth area critical to AI-datacenter power supplies and vehicle inverters.

themes.definitionEn: Manufacturers of electronic components—capacitors, PCBs, connectors, crystal devices, RF/optical parts, copper foil, sensors, and micro-motors—named in Japan's economic-security supply-chain measures for electronic-component materials.

themes.definitionEn: Makers of MLCC capacitors, SAW/BAW RF filters, and magnetic sensors—designated "advanced electronic components" under Japan's Economic Security Promotion Act as a specified critical material.

themes.labelJa: 経済安全保障重要物資
themes.definitionJa: 経済安全保障推進法に基づき政府が指定する16の特定重要物資(半導体、蓄電池、永久磁石、工作機械・産業用ロボット、航空機部品、船舶部品、重要鉱物、クラウドプログラム、先端電子部品、抗菌性物質製剤、肥料、天然ガス、人工衛星、ロケット部品、無人航空機等)の供給網に関わる企業群。
themes.definitionEn: Companies across the supply chains of Japan's 16 government-designated "specified critical materials" under the Economic Security Promotion Act—semiconductors, batteries, permanent magnets, machine tools/robots, aircraft and ship parts, critical minerals, cloud programs, advanced electronic components, antibiotics, fertilizer, natural gas, satellites, rockets, and drones.

themes.definitionJa: マンガン・ニッケル・コバルト・希土類金属・ウランなど34鉱種を「金属鉱産物」として特定重要物資に指定し、供給源多角化・備蓄を進める対象となる鉱物資源関連企業群。
themes.definitionEn: Companies tied to the 34 "metallic mineral" species (manganese, nickel, cobalt, rare earths, uranium, etc.) designated as a specified critical material under Japan's economic security law, targeted for supply diversification and stockpiling.

themes.definitionEn: Permanent-magnet manufacturers (e.g. neodymium magnets), designated both as an economic-security critical material and as a key product under the "materials" field of Japan's growth strategy.

themes.definitionJa: 工作機械および産業用ロボットの製造企業群。経済安全保障推進法で単一の特定重要物資として指定され、制御関連機器や専用部素材を含む国内生産基盤強化の対象となっている。
themes.definitionEn: Makers of machine tools and industrial robots, jointly designated as a single specified critical material under Japan's economic security law, with a focus on strengthening domestic production of control equipment and dedicated parts.

themes.definitionEn: Factory-automation and robotics companies—industrial and service robots, FA controllers, precision reducers—underpinning the "physical AI (especially AI robots)" theme that leads Japan's growth-strategy AI/semiconductor field.

themes.definitionEn: Companies in the 16 priority decarbonization/energy-transition fields—steel, chemicals, autos, batteries, hydrogen, next-gen renewables, nuclear, fusion, CCS—set out in METI's "Sector-by-Sector Investment Strategy" for GX.

themes.definitionJa: 水電解装置・燃料電池など水素の製造・利用機器を手掛ける企業群。GX分野別投資戦略「水素等」分野で製造設備投資支援の対象とされている。
themes.definitionEn: Makers of water-electrolysis equipment and fuel cells for hydrogen production and use, supported under the "hydrogen etc." field of Japan's GX sector investment strategy.

themes.definitionJa: 次世代革新炉(高速炉・高温ガス炉等)や核燃料、フュージョンエネルギーに関わる企業群。日本成長戦略の戦略分野であり、GX分野別投資戦略でもナトリウム冷却高速炉等が重点技術とされる。
themes.definitionEn: Companies in next-generation nuclear reactors (fast reactors, HTGRs), nuclear fuel, and fusion energy—strategic fields in Japan's growth strategy, with sodium-cooled fast reactors highlighted under the GX investment strategy.
